title: Steph Curry's Snubbed Acting Role: A Missed Opportunity
text:
Despite a positive critical reception, Peacock has canceled the Steph Curry comedy, Mr. Throwback , after just one season. This article delves into the reasons behind Mr. Throwback ‘s surprising demise, exploring viewership issues and potential missed opportunities. Read on to uncover the factors that led to the show’s cancellation and whether a future comeback is absolutely possible.

Peacock Pulls the Plug on Steph Curry’s ‘Mr. Throwback’ After One Season April 16, 2025
The streaming service has canceled the comedy series starring the NBA star, despite a decent critical reception. What whent wrong,and could a potential NBA-NBC reunion offer a chance for revival?
Show’s Over: ‘Mr. Throwback’ Benched Peacock has decided not too renew Mr. Throwback , the mockumentary series featuring NBA superstar Steph Curry, for a second season [1] . This marks Curry’s scripted acting debut and the first live-action series produced by his Unanimous Media banner. The cancellation is reportedly due to low viewership.
Key Players:
Steph Curry: NBA superstar and executive producer, playing a fictionalized version of himself. Adam Pally : Comedic actor playing Danny grossman, the titular Mr. Throwback. Ego Nwodim : SNL star,portraying Kimberly Gregg,Curry’s childhood friend and business partner [3] . Critical Reception vs. Viewership Despite the cancellation, Mr. Throwback garnered a relatively positive reception. The six-episode first season holds an 86% rating among TV critics on rotten Tomatoes and an 80% audience score.
Tho, one review noted that the show never quite lives up to Curry’s charm or pedigree.
Nielsen ratings tell a different story. Mr. throwback never cracked Nielsen’s streaming top 10. Another Peacock series, Based on a True Story , also received the axe after one season, charting only once on Nielsen’s originals list [2] .
A Buddy comedy with a Sports Twist The series revolves around Danny Grossman (Adam Pally),a down-on-his-luck sports memorabilia dealer seeking to recover from debt. He attempts to reunite with his sixth-grade basketball teammate, Steph Curry, to achieve redemption.
Pally played a down-on-his-luck sports-memorabilia dealer seeking redemption (well,at first he was merely seeking game-used curry duds to get out of a debt) by reuniting with his sixth-grade basketball teammate,Curry.
The show features Ego Nwodim as Kimberly Gregg, Curry’s childhood friend turned professional partner, and Ayden Mayeri.
Missed Opportunities and a Potential Comeback? The show debuted on Peacock on August 8, 2024. Two days later, Curry led the U.S. men’s basketball team to a gold medal on the same platform. Adam Pally was present at the game, and Curry made a Mr. Throwback reference from the podium.
NBCUniversal executives reportedly celebrated this moment of corporate synergy, viewing it as a potential boost after Peacock’s troubled launch in 2020.
NBCU highlighted that 77% of peacock accounts that watched Mr. Throwback during its opening weekend also watched basketball at the Olympics. Though, the disparity in audience size between the two was significant.
Despite attempts to boost viewership by airing Mr. Throwback on NBC, the show failed to gain traction.
